title: kate-core: replace a list of ranges in one transaction
summary: Command::ReplaceRanges holds pairs of a character range and the new text. The workspace builds one Transaction from them and applies it with EditKind::Replace, so undo is one step. The find bar uses it for Replace and Replace All.

lane.reason: A Cursor cloud agent codes this packet. workspace.rs is a 3,500-line file and the change touches its command dispatch. The Linux VM builds and tests kate-core. The owner Mac stays free for the window.

definitions.definition:
/// Build one Edit per pair, sort them into a Transaction, and apply it as a Replace.
fn replace_ranges_cmd(ws: &mut Workspace, view: ViewId, pairs: &[(CharRange, String)]) -> Result<(), CommandError>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add ReplaceRanges after InsertText in command.rs and import CharRange there. Add the arm to run_text. replace_ranges_cmd builds Edit { start: range.start(), old: buffer.slice(range).to_string(), new: text.clone() } for each pair, calls Transaction::new(edits) and maps the error to CommandError::Transaction, returns Ok(()) for an empty transaction, and calls apply_change(ws, view, tx, None, EditKind::Replace). A range past the buffer length is clamped before the slice. The test replace_ranges_applies_one_transaction types aXbXc, executes ReplaceRanges with ranges 1..2 and 3..4 both to yy, asserts the text is ayybyyc, executes Undo, and asserts the text is aXbXc. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::replace_ranges_applies_one_transaction
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because Command::ReplaceRanges does not exist. After the change both ranges change in one step and one Undo restores the text.
